name: ContextASR-Bench
description:
ContextASR-Bench: A Massive Contextual Speech Recognition Benchmark
	

Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) has been extensively investigated, yet prior benchmarks have largely focused on assessing the acoustic robustness of ASR models, leaving evaluations of their linguistic capabilities relatively underexplored. This largely stems from the limited parameter sizes and training corpora of conventional ASR models, leaving them with insufficient world knowledge, which is crucial for… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/bsmu666/ContextASR-Bench.
reputation: A newly released Hugging Face benchmark for contextual ASR; useful for research but not yet widely cited or adopted.
